header.subtitle: Convert and prepare your CSV exports without using the command line. Everything is processed in your browser: no file ever leaves your computer.

convert.title: Convert StoryGraph to Goodreads
convert.description: Transform your StoryGraph export into the format Goodreads can import: shelves, dates, ratings, ISBN and reviews included.
convert.placeholder: Click to choose your StoryGraph export (.csv)
convert.splitOption: Split the result into smaller files

compare.title: Compare two libraries
compare.description: Get the books that are in the new file but not in your existing library (matching by ISBN, or by title and author). Useful to avoid importing duplicates.
compare.result: {{count}} books from the new file are not in your library.

split.title: Split a large file
split.description: If your CSV is too large to import at once, split it into smaller parts or separate it by read status.
split.placeholder: Click to choose the CSV file to split

year.title: Split by year
year.description: Create one file per year of your library, or export only the books of a specific year. A book counts for a year if any of its dates (added, read or last read) falls in that year.
year.placeholder: Click to choose your StoryGraph export (.csv)

errors.emptyFile: The file "{{name}}" is empty or not a valid CSV.
errors.titleColumn: The title column was not found in one of the files.
errors.yearFormat: The year must have 4 digits, for example 2025.
errors.noBooksForYear: There are no books associated with the year {{year}}.

footer.privacy: Files are processed locally in your browser; nothing is uploaded to any server.
